mission.title: Mission & Vision
mission.missionText: A model modern mahdara that strives through distinguished programs to graduate skilled, proficient reciters who excel in the Holy Qur'an and its sciences.
mission.visionText: To serve as an illuminating beacon of knowledge for teaching the Holy Qur'an and its associated disciplines.

items.title: Precision in Memorization
items.desc: Ensuring proficient memorization of the Book of Allah paired with proper Tajweed rules and vocal execution.

items.title: Rigorous Tracking
items.desc: Implementing a precise follow-up and monitoring mechanism for students' memorization and revision cycles.

items.title: Foundational Literacy
items.desc: Eliminating reading and writing challenges at the foundational stage using structured phonetic spelling methods.

items.title: Talent Incubation
items.desc: Discovering and actively developing student talents.

items.title: Competition Readiness
items.desc: Qualifying students to compete in local, national, and international Qur'anic competitions.

activities.title: Educational Activities
activities.intro: The institution places strong emphasis on extracurricular activities in order to:
items: Bridge theoretical knowledge with hands-on practice.
Foster critical thinking skills, self-confidence, and a sense of responsibility.
Instill authentic Islamic values and high moral character.
